description.en: Set of labels for the metric.

description.zh: 截止时间，默认是当前时间。
description.en: End time. Default is the current time.

description.zh:
监控指标的类型，取值如下：
- NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond：每秒网络请求接收量。
- NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond：每秒网络请求发送量。
- FrontendThroughputBytes：前端服务吞吐。
- FrontendLatencyMicrosecond：前端服务延迟。
- FrontendIops：前端服务读取频率。
description.en:
Type of metric. Valid values:

- NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond: Bytes received per second over the network.

- NetworkTransmitBytesPerSecond: Bytes sent per second over the network.

- FrontendThroughputBytes: Frontend service throughput in bytes.

- FrontendLatencyMicrosecond: Frontend service latency in microseconds.

- FrontendIops: Frontend service read frequency (IOPS).

description.zh: 监控指标所属的数据集加速槽ID。如何获取加速槽ID，请参见[ListSlots](~~467905~~)。
description.en: ID of the dataset acceleration slot that owns the metrics. To get a slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).

description.zh: 起始时间，默认是1小时前。
description.en: Start time. Default is one hour before now.

descriptions.zh:
- 请求参数的作用类似于一个过滤器，过滤器为逻辑与（AND）关系。如果某一参数为空，则过滤器不起作用。
- 在查询时，管控层会将SlotId默认加入到筛选条件中，因此需要监控指标采集时关联到SlotId上，方可被查询出来。
descriptions.en:
- Request parameters function as filters and are combined using a logical AND. If a parameter is left empty, it is ignored.

- When you query metrics, the control plane automatically adds the SlotId to the filter conditions. As a result, only metrics that were associated with a SlotId during collection are returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator query-slot-metrics --slot-id slot-abcdefgh120000 --dimensions SlotIDs:_xxx --metric-type NetworkReceiveBytesPerSecond --start-time 2020-11-08T15:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-08T16:00:00Z --time-step 5m --region cn-hangzhou
